description: This file contains the initial schema and migration script for setting up a PostgreSQL database for the Energy Insights Platform. It defines tables, indexes, triggers, and functions essential for multi-tenant energy data management, including tenants, users, roles, meters, meter readings, documents, analytics outputs, alerts, and audit logs.

methods.name: set_updated_at
methods.description: A trigger function that updates the 'updated_at' timestamp on modification of a row.
